fields.name: ClusterClientDbOptions library configuration record
fields.contract: ClusterClientDbOptions exposes a mutable configuration record for a cluster client. Its public contract carries: a required DatabaseKey initialized to "Common"; an optional ConnectionString initialized to null; an optional GatewayListQuery initialized to null, which a provider package's gateway list provider replaces with that package's own query (ArgentSea.Orleans.Sql: rdr.OrleansClusterGatewayListV1; ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg: rdr.orleans_cluster_gateway_list_v1), so the provider-neutral record names no platform-specific query; and a MaxRefreshInterval initialized to 60 seconds.
